name: type1-to-geojson
reference: Type 1: lat, lon, course, speed_ms reach the Feature. geojson writes coordinates [lon, lat], properties in field-line order (callsign, course, speed_ms), then id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); uid is derived as text_of(ais.mmsi) (model/ais.def), so it is checked with @complete.
